svg.title: Node fill and seeding across trigger faces
svg.desc: A leaf fill with sweep numbers, and a lower node fill seeded by its leaves.
svg.text: Number = the sweep in which the voxel turns on.
5 sweeps turn voxels on; sweep 6 changes nothing.
Leaves are walls; seeds arrive across the leaves’ trigger faces.
Drawn with 8×8 slots; a lower node has 16³.
In (b) a leaf is drawn as a child slot (wall), with its narrow band in miniature.
